text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation as I enter this clean, modern space filled with movement and energy. The presence of children and the lab-like atmosphere suggest a place of discovery and learning. The vibrant R+D installation inside heightens my sense of intrigue—the celebration of research and innovation calls to my philosophical desire to question, to explore, and to contemplate how humans interact with technology. I am eager to see, listen, and reflect on what knowledge or insight I might encounter here.
